QuestInfo.name: Icarus the Delinquent
QuestInfo.1: Apparently Shumi near the Subway needs help. Why can't Icarus take care of it himself? Well, do you want the job, or not?
QuestInfo.2: Shumi was looking for something she lost.

0.0: So BORED! Hey, you! Alex told me about you! You got any money? I lost my wallet, and need to borrow some cash for the taxi. I just need...about...1 million Mesos.?\r\n#L0##bI don't have that kind of money...#l\n#k
0.1: Really?!\r\n#L0##bYeah. I just got here... (The kids in this city are scary...)#l\n#k
0.2: Dang. Oh well. If you can't give me a loan, just do me a favor, and we'll call it even.

yes.0: All the way to the left of the city, there's the Subway, right? There's a blonde girl there. Help her out, and we'll call it even.

no.0: You won't give me money, you won't do me favors... What good are you, anyway?

1.0: Gosh, I lost it again. What to do?

npc.0: Hey, slowpoke! I told you to help Shumi! What're you still doing here?
